findings.title: Consume recovery codes in the test provider and test their lifecycle
findings.body: The new recovery-code validator returns true for any matching code without removing or marking it used. Moreover, getCredentials() reconstructs the credential from the unchanged full list on every call. Consequently, the same recovery code can authenticate indefinitely, the login form always requests code 0, and the exhausted-code regeneration path is never exercised. The new integration test only performs one login, so it passes despite this violation of the single-use recovery-code contract. Make successful validation consume the code, expose the remaining-code state, and test replay rejection, progression to the next code, and regeneration after exhaustion.
